## Appearance

Blewett is a small woman with a shrewish face. She has a very lean build, lacking any superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## History

Blewett is a harsh woman who offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to address the adoption mix-up. Her unpleasant demeanor causes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate about placing the young girl in her care. Ultimately, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) chooses to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of handing her over to Blewett.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P1](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P2](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P11](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P16](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0016), +9 more_
